pluginConfigFields.label: Simulated AXT600
pluginConfigFields.help: Adds a pretend AXT600 to the device picker, scanning at the speed a real one does, so the plugin can be tried without the hardware. Real AXT600s on the network are found by themselves.

deviceConfigFields.label: IP address
deviceConfigFields.help: The AXT600's address, shown on its front panel under Network. It has to be on the same network (subnet) as this computer.

deviceConfigFields.label: Component ID
deviceConfigFields.help: Normally left empty: the AXT600 announces its own. Fill it in only if this unit is never found by itself, with the 32 hexadecimal digits of its ACN component ID.
